name: Blast Mine stays armed under an enemy until Remote Detonation (#9155)
contract: Deploy Blast Mine 801718 names exactly two triggers: 'When the mine is destroyed, or upon using Remote
Detonation, up to $802336i nearby targets are blasted away and enemies take a minor amount of Fire damage.'
The mine passive 572376 adds only 'Upon being killed this mine will explode', and the live mine 50045 casts only
Bomb Ready 500354, Remote Bomb Explosion 802336 and its trigger 802786. #8642 made the mine explode whenever a
valid enemy came within 2 yd, so a level 6 Tinker fighting next to their mine saw it fire on its own and its
Remote Bomb Knockback 804306 (TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_PARTY, 8 yd) launch them. Expected: a hostile golem 1 yd
from the mine, with the Tinker 3 yd from it, leaves the mine armed for five seconds, takes no damage and sends
the Tinker no SMSG_MOVE_KNOCK_BACK (239); Remote Detonation 801798 then explodes it and damages the golem.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Remote Detonation is known with Deploy Blast Mine
Deploy the mine 1 yd from the golem
The golem stands on the mine next to the Tinker
The mine does not fire on its own
The golem took no explosion damage
SETUP: the mine grants Bomb Ready
